design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat muted colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, at most one small lit accent. Full body, strict side view facing right, the whole figure from the top of the head to the soles inside the frame, tall in the frame: the figure fills nine tenths of the picture height. The character stands upright and still, like a model sheet: weight evenly on both feet, hips and shoulders level, the spine vertical, the chest not pushed out and the lower back not arched, the head level. The near arm hangs straight down beside the thigh with an open empty hand; it is not swept back. The far arm is hidden behind the torso. The feet are a small step apart with the far foot half a step ahead, so the far shin and the far shoe show in front of the near leg. Xiaowei, a quiet girl of twelve, a child: about five and a half heads tall, small and slight with a child's round face and short limbs, standing a little shyly but upright. Chin-length black bob with a straight fringe, held back on one side by a plain yellow hair clip, pale tired eyes, a small mouth. She wears a short hand-me-down faded mustard-yellow children's rain jacket that ends at the belt line, well above the thighs, buttoned to the collar with the hood down, the cuffs rolled twice; under it a plain grey knitted jumper; dark blue trousers down to the ankles, slightly too short; small faded red rubber rain boots; a woven string bracelet on the wrist. Everything is clean but worn thin and mended. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles where the cloth bends, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face. Few large plain shapes, no decorative details beyond the ones described. Even overcast light, no glow, no bloom, no text.
